title: Sensors, Actuators and Embedded Systems
welcome_lead: Embed computers everywhere with sensors that feel and actuators that act.
meta_desc: IBDP CS adventure on sensors, actuators and embedded control systems.
final_note: Sense, decide, act - the embedded mantra!

concepts.def: Converts physical quantity to electrical signal.
CPU + memory + I/O on one chip.
Software stored in non-volatile chip memory.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Thermostat senses temp, compares to setpoint.

Heater (actuator) turned on/off accordingly - simple control loop.

10-bit ADC sampling 0-5V gives 1024 levels.

Each step ≈ 4.88 mV resolution.

Pins read sensors via ADC, drive actuators via PWM.

Firmware orchestrates I/O within real-time constraints.
